correctness.rationale: For disease-free spatially constant initial data with positive healthy density, the spore, latent, infectious, and removed variables are identically zero until the source senescence switch. The healthy density then follows a positive logistic equation. Immediately after the switch the printed removed equation has strictly negative derivative at the boundary \(R=0\), so the nonnegative cone is not forward invariant. The source finite-difference update has the same sign. Summing the four host equations independently reproduces the source total-density balance with the doubled senescence loss.

value.rationale: The removed density is used in the denominator of the paper’s disease-severity quantity and is one of the five simulated state variables. A model that can drive this density negative from admissible nonnegative data loses the compartment interpretation on which the severity calculation rests. The obstruction is exact, occurs under the paper’s own senescence mechanism and parameter scale, and identifies the precise equation that must be changed before positivity-based biological interpretation can be justified.
